goal: Recover current upgrade evidence through the canonical Flow lifecycle after stale test evidence recovery, so upgrade-required changes can reach impl-gate without a manual senti upgrade.

in: Recovery of upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log after stale test evidence invalidation.
Canonical test-execute to impl-gate behavior for upgrade-required changed paths.
Fail-closed validation of reused or regenerated upgrade evidence.
Durable audit evidence for preserve, reuse, regenerate, missing, and stale recovery decisions.

Spec-local coverage plus shared lifecycle regression coverage in tests/unit/flow/stale-test-evidence-refresh.test.js, tests/unit/flow/upgrade-required-changed-paths.test.js, and tests/unit/flow/gate-phase-inference.test.js.
out: Accepting stale, missing, malformed, failed, or authority-mismatched upgrade evidence as current.
Changing Issue #458 repair manifest, ledger, or repair delta transaction continuity.

constraints: Use only Node.js built-in modules; do not add external dependencies.

Reuse upgrade evidence only when current repair fingerprint, current checkedPaths, flow target authority, schema-valid successful upgrade-result.json, rawLogDigest, and existing raw upgrade log all match.
When no upgrade-required source paths are present, do not run senti upgrade and do not require an upgrade artifact for impl-gate.
Missing, malformed, failed, stale, raw-log-missing, or authority-mismatched evidence must remain fail-closed and must not be accepted as current evidence.
Recovery decisions and artifact mutations must be owned by the canonical lifecycle path before impl-gate, not by a user-required manual workaround.
Represent meaningful recovery decisions, authority, and artifact validation concepts with dedicated classes that enforce invariants.

Existing feature impact: stale test evidence refresh continues to rewind to test-execute, upgrade-required changed path detection remains strict, and impl-gate remains fail-closed for invalid upgrade evidence while gaining canonical current-evidence recovery before evaluation.

Migration parity inventory: the retained public behavior of user-run senti upgrade is limited to producing upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log for upgrade-required changed paths, preserving command/result/raw-log validation semantics, and leaving user-facing command behavior unchanged. New ownership maps changed-path detection to src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js, stale refresh rewind to src/flow/lib/stale-test-evidence-refresh.js, pre-gate recovery orchestration to src/flow/lib/run-gate.js, artifact writing and validation to src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js, generated artifact paths to upgrade-result.json, tests/.raw/upgrade.log, and upgrade-recovery-audit.json, and step-state side effects to the existing flow lifecycle hooks. No user-facing commands, APIs, hooks, config entries, or generated artifact formats are removed.
design_principles: Keep stale evidence recovery and integration gate behavior aligned with existing artifact validation contracts.
Treat upgrade evidence as proof for the current source state, not merely as a file-presence check.
Make the recovery path auditable enough to explain whether evidence was bypassed, reused, or regenerated.

modules.text: src/flow/lib/impl-repair-artifacts.js owns repair transactions, artifact invalidation, lifecycle reset, and issue-log evidence.
src/flow/lib/stale-test-evidence-refresh.js detects stale repair fingerprints and returns the active lifecycle to test-execute after delegated invalidation.
src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js detects upgrade-required changed paths, writes upgrade result/raw-log artifacts, validates gate evidence, and hosts upgrade evidence recovery logic.
src/flow/lib/run-gate.js owns integration precheck orchestration before semantic impl-gate evaluation.
src/flow/definition.js defines test-execute before impl-gate in the canonical lifecycle.
src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js keeps upgrade-result.json validation fail-closed for checkedPaths, result status, raw-log existence, rawLogDigest, and recoveryAuthority target/fingerprint checks.

data_flow.text: Stale recovery invalidates downstream artifacts and returns the active lifecycle to test-execute.
Before impl-gate evaluation, the canonical path determines whether current changed paths require upgrade evidence.
If no required paths remain, recovery records a bypass decision and proceeds without upgrade artifacts.
If required paths remain, current evidence is reused only when fingerprint, checkedPaths, target authority, raw-log digest, result schema, and raw log existence all match.
When reusable evidence is absent, stale, missing, or authority-mismatched, the canonical path regenerates upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log before impl-gate.
impl-gate continues to validate the resulting artifact through the existing fail-closed evidence contract.

background: Stale test evidence recovery invalidates downstream upgrade artifacts, including upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log. The draft identifies a lifecycle gap: after returning to test-execute, the normal path can arrive at impl-gate with upgrade-required source changes but without current upgrade evidence, causing validateUpgradeEvidenceForGate to fail on a missing artifact. The fix must preserve the existing fail-closed evidence contract while adding a canonical owner that can bypass, reuse, or regenerate evidence for the current source state.

requirements.desc: After stale test evidence recovery, the canonical path must compute current upgrade-required changed paths and bypass upgrade execution when that list is empty.

When upgrade-required paths exist, the canonical path must reuse or preserve existing upgrade evidence only if current repair fingerprint, current checkedPaths, flow target authority, schema-valid successful result, rawLogDigest, and raw upgrade log existence all match.
When R2 conditions are not met for required paths, the canonical path must regenerate upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log before impl-gate evaluates integration readiness.
Recovery must write audit evidence recording decision, action, reason when applicable, current fingerprint, target authority, checkedPaths, artifact paths, and next active step.

impl-gate evidence validation must continue to reject stale checkedPaths, missing raw logs, malformed artifacts, failed upgrade results, raw-log digest mismatch, and authority mismatch instead of accepting old evidence as current.

Repeated stale recovery in the same flow must still lead to current upgrade evidence for each post-recovery source state and must not re-block impl-gate solely because upgrade-result.json was invalidated.

Tests must cover bypass, preserve or reuse, regenerate, missing, stale, malformed or failed rejection, authority mismatch, raw-log mismatch, and repeated recovery behavior with requirement headers in specs/481-upgrade-evidence-recovery/tests/upgrade-evidence-recovery.test.js plus shared lifecycle regression updates in tests/unit/flow/stale-test-evidence-refresh.test.js, tests/unit/flow/upgrade-required-changed-paths.test.js, and tests/unit/flow/gate-phase-inference.test.js.

Canonical recovery must preserve migration parity for the existing upgrade evidence surface: senti upgrade remains user-callable with unchanged command semantics; upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log keep their existing schema/path contracts; validation continues through validateUpgradeEvidenceForGate; lifecycle step-state changes remain owned by existing Flow hooks; and the only added generated artifact is upgrade-recovery-audit.json.

acceptance_criteria: [AC1/R1] A stale recovery scenario with no upgrade-required changed paths records bypass and does not call senti upgrade.
[AC2/R2] Matching current fingerprint, checkedPaths, target authority, schema-valid successful result, rawLogDigest, and raw log allow evidence reuse or preserve without rerunning upgrade.
[AC3/R3] Missing, stale, authority-mismatched, or digest-mismatched evidence for required paths triggers regeneration of upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log before impl-gate.
[AC4/R4] upgrade-recovery-audit.json includes decision, action, reason when applicable, currentFingerprint, target, checkedPaths, artifactPaths, and nextActiveStep.
[AC5/R5] malformed result, missing raw log, failed result, stale checkedPaths, raw-log digest mismatch, and authority mismatch fail closed and cannot pass impl-gate as current evidence.
[AC6/R6] Two stale recovery cycles in one flow each recover current evidence and do not require a manual senti upgrade workaround.
[AC7/R7] specs/481-upgrade-evidence-recovery/tests/ contains Node tests with // spec: R1 ... R8 headers, and affected shared flow lifecycle tests pass.

[AC8/R8] Behavior-level verification covers the retained public surfaces: user-run senti upgrade semantics are unchanged, upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log contracts remain compatible with validateUpgradeEvidenceForGate, flow hook step-state ownership is unchanged, and upgrade-recovery-audit.json is the only new artifact format.

clarifications.q: What exact conditions allow existing upgrade evidence to be reused?
clarifications.a: The current repair fingerprint, current checkedPaths, flow target authority, schema-valid successful upgrade result, rawLogDigest, and existing raw upgrade log must all match.

clarifications.q: Is upgrade-result.json required when no current upgrade-required path exists?
clarifications.a: No. The existing validateUpgradeEvidenceForGate contract succeeds without an artifact when current required paths are empty.

clarifications.q: Can stale or malformed evidence be kept to unblock impl-gate?
clarifications.a: No. Stale, malformed, failed, missing-log, digest-mismatched, and authority-mismatched evidence remains rejected; recovery must regenerate or fail closed.

clarifications.q: Which existing upgrade behavior is moved or replaced by canonical recovery?
clarifications.a: Manual senti upgrade remains available and unchanged. The canonical lifecycle only takes ownership of producing or reusing current upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log before impl-gate when stale recovery invalidated those artifacts. Existing validation, command semantics, hook-owned step transitions, and config behavior are retained; no public surface is removed.

alternatives_considered.option: Exclude upgrade artifacts from stale recovery invalidation.
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because it can leave evidence for a previous source state available after source changes.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask users to run senti upgrade manually when impl-gate reports missing evidence.
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because it preserves the reported lifecycle blockage and shifts canonical recovery responsibility to the user.

alternatives_considered.option: Accept missing or stale upgrade evidence when test evidence is current.
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because it breaks the fail-closed upgrade evidence contract for checkedPaths, raw logs, target authority, and current source state.
